engines.name: character_personality_anathema
engines.value: You must not commit wanton cruelty to animals or kill animals unnecessarily (this doesn’t prevent you from defending yourself against animals or killing them cleanly for food), despoil natural places, consume more natural resources than you require to live comfortably, or teach the Wildsong to non-druids. If you flagrantly or repeatedly violate these prohibitions, you might lose your primal spellcasting and animal companion abilities.

engines.name: character_campaign_allies
engines.value: The young snow leopard Droogami serves as your companion and protector. You can use the Command an Animal action to give her two actions. Because Droogami is a loyal companion, you do not have to attempt a Nature check to convince her to listen to you.
